description: Side-by-side test results for two to five French online stores you already know, in the order given. Use it when the user hesitates between specific stores. To find candidates first, use trouver_marchands or rechercher_marchand. Returns: marchands, one full result per store, identical to consulter_marchand (score out of 100, six steps acces to caisse, proven facts, machine readability, UCP checkout, summary and page). Each store counts as one request against the rate limit. Fewer than two or more than five domains: error result.

domaines.description: Two to five store domains, for example ["respire.co", "typology.com"].

langue.description: Language of the page links and, for consulter_marchand, of the summary sentence: fr (default) or en. Data fields are the same in both.

name: comparer_marchands
title: Comparer des marchands
